Hooked HUD "Small balance". Re-measured 2026-09-17 (wave48-play-slots, 7e1c9b4f) and the wave 46 residual is CLOSED, though not by the thing that was expected to close it. index.html does now link all six display families, and that was necessary and not sufficient: a linked Google Fonts stylesheet DECLARES an @font-face, and the browser fetches the file only when a RENDERED ELEMENT asks for the family. Phaser draws this bar on a canvas, and a canvas pulls no webfont, so the readouts still resolved the stack's next entry on a cold load. slots/engine/fonts.ts now asks document.fonts for the four kind-stack families plus the running skin's face, inside the same Promise.all as the engine's dynamic imports and raced against a 1200ms deadline, BEFORE the game is constructed - a Phaser Text renders once and keeps its bitmap, so a face that lands after a readout is drawn never reaches the player. Nothing blocks on it; a face that misses the window falls through the CSS stack. fonts.test.ts pins both ends, including that index.html links every family the engine names. No browser ran. Geometry is wave 45's live read, unchanged and still matched: 502x64, pl 24 pr 16 py 2 r16; left group (24,14) 180.333x36 with the glyph at 24, Balance at 64, Win at 122; right group (247,-9) 239x82 with the bet label 247, the 18px coin at 247 on the value's row, value 269, carets 24x50 at 332 on a 2 gap, spin 82x82 at 368, autoplay 462; 247 + 239 + 16 = 502. Face {Mouse Memoirs, flat, 22, portrait 16}, values palette.win #82E9FF, captions palette.barText #FFFFFF at 0.64. FLAT is the load-bearing half: #82E9FF under grad-gold would draw Starbound's orange break at 59.125% across a blue bar.
